verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents cron triggers to create and manage recurring workflow schedules natively in its SDKs, plus first-class scheduling/orchestration as a core platform capability (control plane manages workflows/schedules/tasks), corroborated by GitHub and community descriptions of it as a workflow/task orchestration platform. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of recurring cron scheduling in production, and more detail on schedule management via CLI/UI beyond SDK docs.
